notes.title: Playtest Event Announced! & Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 8!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have two exciting announcements for you today!

1) Official Discord Members Only! Playtest Event!

We will be distributing a Demo build of "Jelly Troops" exclusively to members of our official Discord server for three days only: April 25th to April 27th（JST）, 2025.

Why not spend your weekend having fun with the simple yet deep gameplay of "Jelly Troops"?
This time, you can enjoy the following modes:
・"Split-Screen Versus" for 2 players
・"Random Match" to play against online rivals
・"Private Match" to play with your friends online

Official Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/rM7QVvQYDg

We are planning to hold tournaments on the official Discord server in the future. Join now so you don't miss any information!

2) Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 8!

Following our previous appearance at "Tokyo Game Dungeon 7," we will also be exhibiting at "Tokyo Game Dungeon 8" on Sunday, May 4th!

At our booth, you can try out the latest demo version of "Jelly Troops." Furthermore, those who play the game will receive a "sticker" and a "button badge," and those who have wishlisted the game will also receive a "squishy keychain" as a set!
*Please note that the quantity of merchandise is limited, so if you want them, please come early!

We sincerely look forward to seeing you at the event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097677/0522611d84bfc1c3aeb86de0a2db27df722b610f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: "Jelly Troops" to Exhibit at TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that "Jelly Troops" will be showcased at TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025 (TIGS),
 held in Kichijoji, Tokyo, for two days starting Saturday, March 8th!

 We've planned a range of exciting activities to coincide with the event!
 (*All times are in Japan Standard Time.)

[url=#title2]Jelly Troops Official Tournament & Discord Events![/url]
[url=#title3]4th playtest held!![/url] 
[url=#title1]Overview of the TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025[/url]




[h1=title2]Jelly Troops Official Tournament at TIGS! Predict the Winner and Win a steam Gift Code![/h1]

The official Jelly Troops tournament will be streamed live on the TIGS official YouTube channel 
as part of the stage events at TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025! 
Subscribe to the channel and join us in watching the action!

TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT Official YouTube Channel
https://www.youtube.com/@TokyoIndieGamesSummit

We're also hosting a "TIGS Winner Prediction" event on the Jelly Troops official Discord server!
Event Details:
How to Vote: Simply vote for your predicted winner from the four participants displayed in the Discord voting feature.
Everyone on the Discord server can participate, so join us!
Event Period: Wednesday, March 5, 10:00 AM - Sunday, March 9, 12:00 PM
Participation Bonus: Three lucky participants who correctly predict the winner will receive a 500-point Steam gift code! (Gift codes will be sent via Discord DM.)

Let's rally together, predict the winner, and celebrate Jelly Troops!
[url=discord.gg/rM7QVvQYDg style=button]Jelly Troops official Discord[/url]


[h1=title3]4th Playtest![/h1]

We're holding a user-participation playtest during the TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025 event period.

Playtest Period: Friday, March 7, 10:00 AM - Monday, March 10, 10:00 AM

During the playtest, you can enjoy "Random Match," "Private Match," and "Split Screen Match"! 
Invite your friends or find opponents on our official Discord server.

This playtest includes the following updates:
Guardians can now be destroyed using slime and rockfall magic.
Walls can now be destroyed using rockfall magic.
We encourage you to try out the enhanced "Jelly Troops" and share your impressions and feedback!

Please experience the new "Jelly Troops"!

We are also looking forward to your impressions and feedback after playing!
[url=discord.gg/rM7QVvQYDg style=button]Jelly Troops official Discord[/url]



[h1=title1]Exhibiting at TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2025![/h1]

Event Details:
Dates:
Saturday, March 8, 2025, 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM (Business Day)
Sunday, March 9, 2025, 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Public Day)
Booth: GYAAR Studio Booth GYA-7
For more information about TIGS, please visit the official website.
https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/

Come by our booth for a hands-on experience! 
We'll have a trial play area where you can dive into intense, punipuni battles.

notes.title: Jelly Troops Participates in the Local Multiplayer Playtest Festival!
notes.content:
Hello, Jelly Troops fans!
We are excited to announce that Jelly Troops will be participating in the Steam Local Multiplayer Playtest Festival!

Playtest Period (Pacific Standard Time):
February 10 (Monday) 10:00 AM - February 17 (Monday) 10:00 AM

During the festival, the demo version will feature only the "Private Match" mode.
Invite your friends or join the official Discord to find opponents, and have fun!

Additionally, a new Version 0.3.1 demo has been released with various changes. The main updates are as follows:

Treasure chests have been changed to parcels.
Players can now pick up the parcels directly.
If a slime picks up a parcel, it will carry it to the player.
Parcels that used to appear at the losing player’s base will now appear more frequently near the player’s position.
These changes allow for more strategic and faster-paced matches!
Make sure to try out the updated Jelly Troops!

We look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback in our official Discord!
https://discord.gg/rM7QVvQYDg
